# convoy_subscription_filter (Resource)

A per-event-type payload filter attached to a subscription. Use it instead of `convoy_subscription.filter_config.filter` when different event types need different filters. Do not manage the same event type's filter from both places.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Only deliver invoice.paid events for gold customers, without affecting the
# other event types of the subscription.
resource "convoy_subscription_filter" "gold_invoices" {
  subscription_id = convoy_subscription.acme_invoices.id
  event_type      = "invoice.paid"
  body = jsonencode({
    customer = { tier = "gold" }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event_type` (String) Event type the filter applies to, e.g. `invoice.paid`, or `*`.
- `subscription_id` (String) Subscription the filter belongs to. Changing this forces a new filter.

### Optional

- `body` (String) Match on the event payload. A JSON object (use `jsonencode()`); supports Convoy filter operators such as `$gte`, `$in`, `$or`, `$regex`.
- `headers` (String) Match on request headers. A JSON object (use `jsonencode()`); supports Convoy filter operators such as `$gte`, `$in`, `$or`, `$regex`.
- `path` (String) Match on URL path parameters. A JSON object (use `jsonencode()`); supports Convoy filter operators such as `$gte`, `$in`, `$or`, `$regex`.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the object belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`. Changing this forces a new object to be created.
- `query` (String) Match on URL query parameters. A JSON object (use `jsonencode()`); supports Convoy filter operators such as `$gte`, `$in`, `$or`, `$regex`.

### Read-Only

- `enabled_at` (String) Time the filter became active.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (`uid`) of the filter.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<subscription_id>/<filter_id>, or <subscription_id>/<filter_id> with a provider project_id.
terraform import convoy_subscription_filter.gold_invoices 01H0JA5MEES38RRK3HTEJC647K/01H0JATTVCXZK8FRDX1M1JN3QY/01H0JB0000000000000000000
```
